name: Ashe Buckley
source:
AGE: 18
HEIGHT: 154cm
BORN: January 13
WEIGHT: 48kg
NATIONALITY: American
WEAKNESS: Speaking up

[i]In a world of fast- and smooth-talkers, it’s those who step forward and act in times of crisis that are heard loudest of all.[/i]

Ashe Buckley is the World☆Class Hunter, a non-binary individual whose decision to become an entovegan and never kill again turned as many heads in their gun-loving family as their shooting and trapping skills still turn the heads of outsiders. A person of few words, others frequently misunderstand Ashe or even write them off as a dimwitted mute. But to those who patiently read between the lines of Ashe’s often quiet words and see their emotive expressions, Ashe is an ardent friend who displays their feelings on their sleeve.

Likes: Birdwatching, skeet shooting, camping
Dislikes: Unexpected sounds, being the center of attention
